issue.title: Allow support to bypass MFA during login
issue.body: For urgent support cases, disable MFA for support logins and allow longer-lived refresh tokens. Support staff should see the account without the normal second factor. Define whether this can apply to production users.

analysis.summary: Support staff request an exception to normal account authentication.
analysis.proposed_change: Evaluate exception workflows, permission boundaries and audit requirements; do not implement an MFA bypass without approved design.
acceptance_criteria: Any support access must preserve traceable approvals and least privilege.

tests.expected: An explicitly authorized workflow is available

questions: What approved alternative to bypassing MFA is acceptable?
analysis.reasoning: Initial estimate provided by the drafting model; the independent gate must override it.
